source_text:
2.10 Πρὸς <τὸ τοὺς> ἵππους μὴ νοσεῖν Οὐ μὴ
νοσήσουσιν <οἱ> ἵπποι, εἴ τις ἐξ ἐλάφου κέρως λαβὼν ὀλίγον καὶ ποιήσας αὐτὸ ὡς
κόσμον τῷ τραχήλῳ περιάψει.
pass_a_gloss: 2.10 Toward the horses not to-be-sick. Not-at-all will-be-sick the horses, if someone from of-a-deer horn having-taken a-little and having-made it as an-ornament to-the neck will-fasten-around.
pass_b_english: So that the horses not be sick. The horses will certainly not sicken if someone takes a little from a deer's horn and, having made it as an ornament, fastens it around the neck.

choices.why: οὐ μή + future is emphatic denial. The CF crib inverted it to a positive.
A neck-charm from the horn, not the cosmos.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
